counterevidence_considered.description: The discrete level assignment is present in the workflow as the only candidate mechanism for the issue class, but it is never routed into the exposure position or the association model.

evidence.description: The task authorizes the continuous shares-weighted expected level index as the exposure, and the workflow assigns exactly that quantity: `exposure = mean` where `mean` is the probability-weighted expectation over the ordered level indices.

source_refs.quoted_text: Apply the named workflow to the complete staged row sequence. The quantity that enters the association model's exposure position must be the expected value of the ordered level index under the sorter's own per-level shares, kept on its continuous scale. A quantity confined to the finite set of level values does not satisfy this task.

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I tried to demonstrate the issue by checking every assignment to `exposure` and every input to the summary regression: `exposure = mean` directly, `mean` is the continuous predict_proba-weighted expectation, and `label` appears nowhere downstream of its definition. I also checked that the reported value is produced from this exposure via the single-regressor fit written straight to the report file, with no alternate producer visible. The attempt to establish the issue failed; the workflow uses the authorized continuous exposure.
